g.text: Track 2 curated evidence matrix (external literature + project evidence, not patient observations)

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: Every cell is a versioned row in research/track2_evidence.tsv: 80 cells drawn from 4 distinct publications and 2 internal project artefacts; no cell other than an absent one may lack a source (checked at build time).

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: 61 cells are empty, 9 hold evidence of the exact kind the bridge needs, 3 point against it. Bridge 8 is empty in all ten dimensions

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: (confirmed). Bridge 1, the only one tied to this patient, has 1 non-empty cell and it is near, not direct. Bridge 7 is contradictory in 3 dimensions.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif

g.text: No overall score, weight or ranking is computed. Combining heterogeneous evidence into one number would need a preregistered method, and none exists. An absent cell means no qualifying evidence was identified in our scoped literature search, not that the claim is false and not that nobody has ever looked.

text.style: fill: #5b6670; font: 6.7px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif
